en.headline: Surveyor lifts Stanley and Shek Mun site values after Ho Man Tin tender
en.dek: Vigers raised its Stanley plot estimate by as much as about 42 per cent after Kerry's bid came in well above earlier forecasts.
body: A surveyor has marked up other sites on this year's land-sale list after Kerry Properties won the Fat Kwong Street residential plot in Ho Man Tin for more than 4.308 billion dollars, nearly 40 per cent above market estimates.

RTHK reported that the accommodation value was more than 20,738 dollars a square foot, a five-year high for Kowloon on that measure. Vincent Leung, a senior director at Vigers, said the winning bid was above his own forecast of 2.6 billion dollars.

Leung raised his valuation of the Stanley Cape Road site on the sale list from the 4.32 billion to 4.56 billion dollars he estimated in February to 6 billion to 6.48 billion dollars, an increase of as much as about 42 per cent, or about 12,500 to 13,500 dollars a square foot of floor area. Two residential sites at Shek Mun in Sha Tin were lifted by as much as 60 per cent, to a top accommodation value of about 8,800 dollars a square foot.

He said the Ho Man Tin result continued a pattern seen in an earlier Urban Renewal Authority tender in Hung Hom, and estimated that flats on the Fat Kwong Street project could sell for about 45,000 dollars a square foot, above nearby new projects. Midland Realty senior director Buggle Lau said some owners in the district had stopped negotiating and others planned to raise asking prices by at least 10 per cent.

zh.headline: 測量師上調赤柱及石門地皮估值 何文田投標後
zh.dek: 嘉里以逾43.08億元投得佛光街住宅地後，華坊把環角道地皮估值上調最多約四成二。
body: 何文田佛光街住宅地由嘉里建設以逾43.08億元投得，較市場估值高出近四成後，有測量師調高本年度賣地表其他地皮的估值。
香港電台報道，該地每平方呎樓面地價逾20,738元，創九龍區呎價五年新高。華坊諮詢評估資深董事梁沛泓說，中標價高於他早前預測的26億元。
他把賣地表內赤柱環角道地皮的估值，由2月時的43.2億至45.6億元，上調至60億至64.8億元，升幅最高約42%，折合每平方呎樓面地價約12,500至13,500元。沙田石門兩幅住宅地的上調幅度最高達60%，每平方呎樓面地價最高約8,800元。
梁沛泓說，何文田結果延續早前市建局紅磡地皮中標價遠超預期的走勢，並估計佛光街項目落成後樓價可達每平方呎約45,000元，高於同區新盤。美聯物業高級董事布少明說，招標結果公布後，區內有業主表明不議價，亦有放盤業主計劃加價至少一成。
